faq_items.question: How can I participate in school life?
faq_items.answer: Parents are an important part of our community. We invite families to parenting workshops, community fairs, celebrations, social causes and special events. Contact the team for current arrangements.

faq_items.question: Where can I find programme timings?
faq_items.answer: Timings for every programme are listed on our Programmes page and in the schedule on the Parents page. Please confirm your child’s assigned session with our team.

faq_items.question: How can I share a question with the team?
faq_items.answer: Fill in the enquiry form or call +91 93160 49220, and our team will get back to you.

faq_items.question: How will I receive important school information?
faq_items.answer: Important updates are shared directly with families by the Ananya Tots team. Contact the team for current arrangements.
